simple.meaning: זַלְעָפָה (zalʻâphâh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a glow (of wind or anger); also a famine (as consuming).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.

simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to זַלְעָפָה (H2152).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.

definitions.full: H2152. zalaphah זַלְעָפָה noun feminine raging heat (on formation compare Ges Lbg 863 Ol § 196 a. 1. 2 ) — ׳ז Psa 119:53 ; plural absolute זִלְעָפוֺת 11:6 ; construct זִלְעֲפוֺת Lam 5:10 ; — 1 of fever heat of famine ׳ז רָעָב Lam 5:10 . 2 of burning wind ז ׳רוּח Psa 11:6 (in figurative of ׳י s judgment, with גָּפְרִית אֵשׁ, ). 3 figurative of zeal ׳ז אֲחָזַתְנִי Psa 119:53 .
